_doc: Checked on every French segment (stage 4), on accent-folded lower-case text (foldText: é→e, ’→'). level fail = the segment must change; level review = a candidate the adjudicator looks at in context (these words are good French in other meanings). scope voice = only Evelyn's lines, headlines and reply buttons (kinds bubble, headline, cta); scope all = every segment. Text inside « » (a buyer's quoted words) is exempt from register rules. v2 after Codex's pack review 2026-11-18.

rules.fix: vous / votre / vos (vous everywhere)
possessive ton → votre (the noun « le ton » is fine)
avoir du sens / c'est logique / ça veut dire quelque chose
agir / passer à l'action
prendre une décision

fine in moderation; often « occasion » / « chance » reads more natural

prefer se rendre compte que / comprendre que in Evelyn's voice
'support someone' → soutenir / accompagner; keep « supporter » for bear / tolerate / pay for
tackle → aborder / traiter / résoudre (addressing a question TO someone is fine)
